title: Ingoma Eyashukumisa Iintaba
intro: Uza kutyhila ibali lomkhonzi omangalisayo ka-Allah. Kwilizwe labathunywa nabalawuli, lo mntu wasikelelwa ngencwadi engcwele, ilizwi elinamandla, namandla ngaphezu kwesinyithi. Njengoko ufunda izikhokelo, ngaba ungamchonga lo mntu?
clues: Ndandinelizwi elimnandi, kwaye indumiso yam yayithandwa kangangokuba neenduli neentaka zandilandela.
Ndajongana nomchasi onamandla kwidabi elidumileyo, kwaye nangona ndandimncinci, ndoyisa.
Intsimbi yenziwe yaba lula kum, yandenza ndakwazi ukwenza izixhobo ngezandla zam.
Ndenziwa umlawuli phezu kwesizwe esikhulu, kwaye ubulumko bam ekugwebeni baduma.
Unyana wam, naye owayengumprofeti, wanikwa ulawulo phezu komoya kunye neejinn.
arabic: إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا ٱلْجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِشْرَاقِ
verse: Indeed, We subjected the mountains [to praise] with him, exalting [Allāh] in the [late] afternoon and [after] sunrise. (38:18)
